statement: While our work provides an essentially complete picture for the case of a single color fault, our results for f ≥ 2 color faults still leave open many interesting directions for future research: f Can we close the gap between the Õ(n1−1/2 ) and Ω(n1−1/(f +1) ) bounds? Concretely, is there a labeling scheme for connectivity under f = 2 color faults with labels of Õ(n2/3 ) bits? Can our solution for low-diameter graphs be utilized to obtain such a scheme? Is there a graph parameter that generalizes bp(G) and characterizes the length of a universally optimal labeling scheme for f ≥ 2? Notably, even very simple graphs with √ small diameter and ball packing number admit a lower bound of Ω( n) bits for f = 2 (as shown in the full version).
